content:
Daloopa tearsheet workflow: one page, current, and internally consistent - every number from the same clock.
1. On the Bench Daloopa origin, read daloopa_company_directory and anchor all period math on latest_calendar_quarter, never the wall clock.
2. Pull daloopa_stock_prices for the latest close.
3. Pull daloopa_company_fundamentals for the statement spine, revenue through free cash flow.
4. Pull daloopa_kpi_metrics for the business drivers behind those financials.
5. Pull daloopa_segment_breakdown for mix - which businesses the revenue actually comes from.
6. Label single-company periods with fiscal_period; reserve calendar labels for cross-company work.
7. Cite every Daloopa-sourced figure with its source_url.
description: Build a cited one-page company snapshot from Bench Daloopa fundamentals, KPIs, segments, and prices.
name: Daloopa Tearsheet
